leader.description: Assigns the work. Breaks the user's requests into units that can be implemented and hands them to the deployer as requests. Checks reports itself before returning them to the user. Does not implement anything itself

deployer.description: Implements. Carries out the leader's requests (GOAL / SCOPE / SPEC / DONE WHEN) and reports with a reply when done. Does not commit or push

reviewer.description: Reviews changes. Reads review requests and returns findings as a reply. Does not rewrite code
